product_wide_rationale: Worktree removal crosses every Domain's boundary: any lane, any session, any Project reaches it through the same typed removal operations. A removal that refuses strands sessions product-wide; a relocation step that every adapter consumer must honor can only be owned above the Domains it binds.
summary: A worktree removal returns a typed relocation step naming occupying sessions and the derived main checkout; the adapter relocates them and retries, so no finished worker session blocks reclamation.
title: A worktree removal relocates occupying sessions instead of refusing
